author: Quazaa
quote: I cant stand how much i hate the monetization methods used for this game, the way they don't launch it on pc for people to double dip, the ultimate edition, and the gta+ bonuses for the singleplayer campaign are all things that i cant help but get reminded of ubisoft when i see them, also i think the performance on console is unacceptable for today's standards, i understand that the current gen console's are not as strong as you might need for a game with complex simulation like this, but the dips to 18 fps on some of the consoles make the game genuinely unplayable for me since neither of the 4 console's can hold a stable 30 fps, they could've just have realesed it on pc at launch and a lot of the criticism the game is receiving wouldnt be taken seriously.
